tid_tutorial_message_intro-message-1: Welcome to <color=#9F00FF>Dragon City 2</color>! This is your Island.

tid_tutorial_message_habitat_1: <color=#9F00FF>Dragons</color> can be placed in <color=#9F00FF>Habitats</color> and start producing <color=#9F00FF>Gold</color> depending on their <color=#9F00FF>dragon level</color>.

tid_tutorial_message_evolution_desc_0: Did you know that dragons can also become stronger by <color=#9F00FF>evolving</color>? Let's try it out!

tid_tutorial_message_evolution_candies: <color=#9F00FF>Each dragon</color> loves a <color=#9F00FF>certain Candy</color>. Get these Candies by <color=#9F00FF>converting duplicate dragons</color>.

tid_tutorial_message_level_up: You're learning quickly! Every time you level up you will <color=#9F00FF>discover new features</color>.

tid_tutorial_message_pre_battle_fog_batt: A <color=#9F00FF>cursed dragon</color> has appeared! Ready to defeat it?

tid_tutorial_message_pve_battle_select_a: Now select Flame's attack. <color=#9F00FF>Flame is strong against Nature</color>!

tid_tutorial_message_cursed-terrain-expl: <color=#9F00FF>This land is cursed</color> and we need to <color=#9F00FF>heal</color> it. Let's figure out how!

tid_tutorial_message_orbs_2: Now <color=#9F00FF>tap the Orb</color> and see what happens!

tid_tutorial_message_open-shop-1: You'll need <color=#9F00FF>more Food</color> to grow your dragons. Let's construct a <color=#9F00FF>new Farm!</color>

tid_tutorial_message_click-goals-button-: Nice job! In order to keep progressing, don't forget to <color=#9F00FF>check your Goals</color> from time to time. See you around!

tid_tutorial_message_pve_desc_0: You've unlocked <color=#9F00FF>Campaign battles!</color> Dragons love exploring outside... Let's go!

tid_tutorial_message_pve_pre_battle_open: You'll unlock <color=#9F00FF>new dragon breeds</color> and <color=#9F00FF>exclusive dragon Eggs!</color>

tid_tutorial_message_pvp_desc_0: You've found the <color=#9F00FF>Coliseum</color>! Here you can challenge other players, ready?

tid_tutorial_message_pvp_trophy_road_ope: You can get <color=#9F00FF>upgrading materials and Candies</color> here! But first, why not introduce yourself?

tid_tutorial_message_select-fog-patch-1: Nice work! <color=#9F00FF>Look at this Fog,</color> it seems we can clear it now. What lies beneath?

tid_tutorial_message_mentor-city-introdu: Welcome to my humble abode! Take some time to explore and return to your Island when you are done. See you there!

tid_tutorial_message_open_shop_to_buy_ha: Dragons need a place to rest. Let's get a new <color=#9F00FF>Habitat</color> for your new dragon!

tid_tutorial_message_PROTO_pvp_trophy_ro: You can check here the Leaderboard! But first, why not introduce yourself?

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_WELCOME_BODY: Hi! My name is Deus and I would like to welcome you into Dragon City 2! We have a lot of work to do so by now you should start checking your next goals! Press <color=#9F00FF><link="https://www.google.com">HERE</link></color> to check some tutorials!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_DAILY_REWARD_BODY: Morning! Take these resources as a help for your today's tasks. I hope you will find them useful! Return tomorrow for a bit more of resources!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_SURVEY_D3_BODY: Hi! Help us to improve the game by answering the next survey and let us know your opinions about how to improve our game! Press <color=#9F00FF><link="https://www.google.com/{0}">HERE</link></color> to open the survey and receive some rewards as gratitude!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D0_REWARD_BODY: Hello! Thanks for helping us rid the land of this damned curse. Let me help you out in return!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D1_REWARD_BODY: So happy you returned! Let's fight the curse back, shall we? Here, let me help!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D2_REWARD_BODY: We're doing great work here! Let's keep at it, shall we?

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D3_REWARD_BODY: Welcome back! With you here, we're doing greater than ever!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D4_REWARD_BODY: Welcome once again! Here, let me help you out a bit!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D5_REWARD_BODY: Look at how much we've been able to achieve, thanks to you! Let me give you these in return!

TID_GAME_INBOX_MESSAGE_D6_REWARD_BODY: Hello, once again! It's incredible how much you've achieved in so little time... I'm impressed! Take these as a gift for your effort. Cheers to you!

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PUNCH: The dragon attacks the target with its paw.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LURE: The dragon draws attention to itself making all rivals aim at it during that turn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLYING_KICK: The dragon jumps into the target with its back legs.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SOOT: Thick smoke that lowers the target's accuracy.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ROCK_RUSH: The dragon tackles the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ROCK_N_ROLL: The dragon hurls several rocks at the target. This may also raise all the user's stats at once.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLAMING_BITE: With fire in its fangs, the dragon bites the target. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_INNER_STRENGTH: The dragon focuses itself to raise its Attack and Speed stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SANDY_WEATHER: The dragon summons a sandstorm for 5 turns. This raises the Sp. Def. stat of all Terra Dragons and damages all dragons except for Terra and Metal types.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HARD_CHARGE: The dragon charges with power against the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARGUARD: Using the power of the star, the dragon raises its Defense and Sp. Def. stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_POISON_IVY: A poisonous thorn stabs the target. This may also poison the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LIFE_LEECH: A Nature-type attack that restores the user's HP by half of the damage taken by the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SPRING_BLIZZARD: A storm of petals that damages all those on the battlefield.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BLAZING_LEAP: The dragon strikes the target while cloaked in flames. This also leaves the target with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ENCHANTMENT: The dragon enchants the target, harshly lowering its Attack stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STEEL_LEAF: Steel leaves slash the target. It has an increased critical-hit ratio.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NATURE_FORCE: The dragon attacks the target with the power of nature. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AQUA_SHOT: The dragon attacks the target with a shot of water.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TSUNAMI: A giant wave that hits all rivals and freezes them.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CONVERSION: The dragon loses some of its HP but raises all its stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WATER_MISSILE: A huge blast of water hits the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLAMES_BIT: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its sea equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RAINY_WEATHER: The dragon summons rain for 5 turns. This power ups Sea-type moves and lowers the power of Flame-type moves.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_INFERNOS_BREEZE: All rivals are hit with an extremely hot gust of wind. This may also leave them with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MINT_WHIRLWIND: The target is trapped in a whirlwind of leaves. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ARCANE_BARRIER: A mysterious shield that protects the user and its ally from status moves. Damage moves are not affected.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BLOSSOMING_DEFENSE: The Defense stat of all Nature dragons on the battlefield is raised.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MERCY: The dragon shows mercy for its rival and leaves it with at least 1 HP.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SMASH: The dragon slams into the target using its whole body.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_POWER_SURGE: The dragon boosts the power of any Electric move that is used in the next turn. It also raises the user's Sp. Def. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CRYSTAL_SHOWER: A storm of crystals crash into the target. This also raises the user's Defense stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_THUNDER_CRASH: An electric blast that strikes the target. This may also make the target flinch.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_RECHARGE: An Electric-type attack that restores the user's HP by half of the damage taken by the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WILDFIRE: The dragon attacks with an intense fire that can defrost the user. It may also leave the target with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MEGA_BEAM: The dragon shoots an extremely powerful beam at the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRIC_WAVE: A giant electrified wave that hits both rivals. It may also leave them with paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BURROW: The user burrows on the first turn then attacks on the next.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRIC_BITE: With electricity in its fangs, the dragon bites the target. This may also make the target flinch or leave it paralyzed.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HIGH_VOLTAGE: A jolt of electricity strikes both rivals. This may also cause paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_WATERSPOUT: The target is wrapped in a tornado of water. This may also confuse the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CRYOTHERAPY: A cold shock that heals your ally. It boosts the speed and buffs the Attack, Sp.Attack, Defense and Sp.Defense

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LAVA_FLOOR: Deals damage. Lowers the enemy speed by 3 stages and it may inflict burn and flinch.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_METEOR: A meteor strikes the target with might and burns them.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FRESH_BREEZE: A gentle, cool breeze boost an ally's Attack and Sp. Attack.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_INTIMIDATION: When entering the battlefield, this dragon lowers the Defense and Sp. Defense of one opponent.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_AUTHORITARIAN: When entering the battlefield, this dragon lowers the Attack of both opponents.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PARANORMAL_FLAME: Deals damage. It may also lower the opponent's combo bar.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_THUNDERING_ROAR: This combo makes both opponents flinch and harshly lowers their speed.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_GUERRILLA_TACTICS: Area attack that poisons the targets and lowers their accuracy.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TEMPER: The dragon attacks with hot metal. This may also increase the user's Sp. Defense.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LIGHT_SWORD: A powerful sword made of light hits the opponent and lowers its speed by one stage.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BAD_BREATH: When entering the battle, the dragon poisons a random opponent.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BOULDER: A large rock falls into the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_EARTHQUAKE: The ground under the target bursts with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLAMING_ARROW: A small flame is hurled at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NUCLEAR_HIT: The dragon attacks with an intense fire. It may leave the target with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_IGNITION: The dragon produces special flames that lowers the target's Sp. Atk. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MAGMA_STORM: The target is attacked with a ball of lava. This also raises the user's Sp. Atk. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DESERT_STORM: A blizzard of burning sand hits the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SHOCK_WAVE: The dragon stomps the ground and creates a shock wave that hits all rivals. This also lowers all rivals' Speed stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_OUTBURST: A powerful, physical Terra attack that damages both rivals.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STITCHING_ROOTS: Huge roots rise from the ground and damage the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_THORN_ARMOR: The dragon grows a shield of thorns to protect itself from attacks and causes damage to any attacker that comes into contact with it.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HOWL: A howl that lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk. stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_STARE: The dragon gives an intimidating look that lowers the Defense stat of all rivals.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_NIGHTSHADE_SPORES: The target is damaged by poisonous spores. This may also leave the target poisoned.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_MOONSHINE: Using the power of the moon, the dragon attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FOCUS: The dragon focuses to land a critical hit the next turn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_HEADBUTT: The dragon strikes the target with its head.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SCUBATTACK: A strong Sea-type move which may also freeze the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SPOUT: The dragon spouts a pressurized waterjet.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SEAS_BIT: A column of water hits the target. When used with its flame equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ASSIST: The ally's HP is restored by up to half of its max HP.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FROST_NOVA: A spiral of snow and ice is thrown at the target. This may also freeze the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CLEAN_SLATE: A move that removes all stat changes from all dragons in battle.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BAFFLING_BUBBLES: A spray of bubbles that hit the target. This may also confuse the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SPARKLING_WATER: Bubbling water is shot at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SNOW_STORM: A blizzard that strikes all rivals and may also freeze them.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_JUNGLE_STRIKE: The dragon strikes the target using the power of jungle. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRIC_SHOCK: A jolt of electricity hits the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_LIGHTNING: A lightning bolt strikes the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRIFY: If the target has not yet moved, its move will be Electric-type during that turn.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_FLICKER: The dragon tackles the target while cloaked in electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SUNNY_WEATHER: The sun shines intensely for 5 turns. This power ups Flame-type moves and lowers the power of Sea-type moves.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BEAM: The dragon shoots a powerful beam at the target. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk. stat.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTROMAGNETISM: An Electric-type attack that affects both rivals. It also lowers their Speed stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_OVERDRIVE: The dragon attacks using high-voltage electricity that increases the speed of the user. This also may leave the target with paralysis.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRO_BALL: An orb of electricity hits the target. The slower the user is compared to the target, the stronger the attack.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DRAGONS_RISE: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk. stats.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_ELECTRIC_WEATHER: The battlefield is electrified for 5 turns and Electric-type attacks are powered up. Dragons can no longer fall asleep.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_TREMOR: Unexpectedly the ground under the target shakes. Lowers the defense and Sp.Defense of the target.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_PAINKILLER: Creates a protective area that heals your allies for 3 turns.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_VEIL: The user heals itself. It may also increase its Defense and Sp. Defense.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_CLEANSE: When this dragon enters the battlefiled, cleans all the buffs and debuffs from its ally and opponents.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_BODYGUARD: When entering the battlefield, this dragon increases the Defense and Sp. Defense of its ally.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_SUPERCONDUCTOR: Mighty area attack that leaves the caster paralyzed.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_DRAGULA: The dragon bites the opponent with sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

TID_MOVE_DESCRIPTION_OUT_OF_TIME: The target loses the sense of time and space and gets confused.
